justification: New free consumer tool (/tools/upzoning-check): per-address Housing-SEPP form eligibility under the 2025 LMR/TOD reforms. ALL eligibility logic is delegated verbatim to the existing tested engine (services/housing_sepp_eligibility.evaluate_eligibility — live 776/752/759/452 gates, heritage suppression, fail-closed); the new code is a thin exposure layer (FastAPI endpoint + rate-limited Next proxy + page) plus 9 route-level tests that run the REAL engine. Pre-impl live smoke test (2026-07-13, 3 real addresses) proved the data path and caught the heritage false-positive a hand-rolled shortcut produces.

break_it.scenario: Heritage lot rendered as LMR-eligible (the Haberfield trap: the 776 exclusion layer is sparse and returns nothing on HCA lots, so a zone+776 shortcut says terraces are allowed in a conservation area)
break_it.what_happens: A maximum-liability false positive on a public consumer surface — telling a heritage-land owner they gained development rights they do not have
break_it.how: the endpoint never composes gates itself — it passes the parsed heritage flag into evaluate_eligibility, whose heritage suppression is engine-tested; test_heritage_lot_suppresses_lmr_forms_but_not_base_forms re-asserts it end-to-end at the route with the real engine running

break_it.scenario: Standards-table outage renders as an empty-but-successful result ('no housing types shown' reads as 'nothing is possible here')
break_it.what_happens: A silent wrong result served during a DB outage — the silent-failure class pre-pr-review #4 exists to catch
break_it.how: evaluate_eligibility returns [] for BOTH non-residential zones and standards failures; the endpoint disambiguates via status ok|not_residential|unavailable and the page renders 'unavailable' as a visible amber outage box stating it is a data outage, not a planning result

break_it.scenario: Unconfirmed lot data (no mappable frontage/area) rendered as a definitive 'does not meet standards'
break_it.what_happens: Grey-as-red: a data gap presented as a failed standard (the Bowral regression class)
break_it.how: the engine's unconfirmed flag flows through asdict untouched; the page renders unconfirmed forms with an amber not-determinable icon and the engine's own hedged reason wording, distinct from both green and grey states

break_it.scenario: Liability language drift on a free public surface ('you can build X' framed as advice or approval)
break_it.what_happens: Consumer-law exposure — same stakes as the paid PDF wording, on an anonymous free page
break_it.how: engine reason strings render verbatim (never rewritten in TS); all new copy passed the banned-word grep clean; the page carries an explicit not-planning-advice paragraph and every result is framed 'subject to a development application'; the eligibility framing is a mapped-standards screen, never an outcome
break_it.repro: grep -inE banned-word list over the three new files returns nothing

break_it.scenario: Live ArcGIS gate failure produces a false eligible (gate query dies, form passes anyway)
break_it.what_happens: Network flake converts into granted development rights
break_it.how: gates are fetched via the engine's own _gate_inputs, which is fail-closed by design (any gate failure -> conservative False, never falsely eligible; engine reasons hedge with 'or area unconfirmed'); the accepted trade-off is a conservative false negative during outages, never a false positive
break_it.repro: existing engine tests test_housing_sepp_eligibility.py pin _gate_inputs fail-safety; endpoint passes gates through without modification

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — after Railway deploy, run one real TOD-positive address (67 Warialda St Kogarah: expect TOD chip yes) and one heritage HCA address (1 Ramsay St Haberfield: expect heritage banner + LMR forms suppressed) through the live page; confirm the Vercel preview renders /tools/upzoning-check.
